pull.title: P03: generate checked learned schema applications only when requested
pull.body:
P03 makes checked learned schemas genuinely incremental: the existing cursor requests only the next application and can now suspend between independently returning application phases.

### Current qualification
- Head: `be423b3f99c5f1e3bb4ea159e2610ecc5e63596a`.
- Exact tree: `e1bee2a7712ff95f14b2c3513f565ff6c26bde8b`, identical to locally qualified `4259cc6196074adfb52ccd997c92c57ca8446aa5`.
- Independent local review: all I1/M1/M2 findings addressed; documentation follow-up N1 addressed; no remaining Critical, Important or Minor findings.
- Full hosted CI on this new head is required before merge. Successful run [35638665371](https://github.com/carstenartur/Regelsuche/actions/runs/35638665371) belongs to the historical `db6d93b1` head, not this correction.

### Changes
- Reuse one private checked-application state machine for the eager path, lazy cursor and independent verifier.
- Retain substitution-domain, instantiation/replacement and target-domain progress before evidence construction. Closing or failure keeps all paid work.
- Add explicit opt-in prepaid receipt revisions. Partial payment is never mathematical authority; completion preserves full mathematical diagnostics without billing the same work again.
- Preserve native/registered v2 receipts, historical artifacts, mathematical authorization and existing resource limits.
- Add multi-rule ordering and independent schema/match/candidate-limit controls; clarify the oracle's actual active provider roster.

### Verification
Genuine behavioral RED was observed before implementation and retained separately in the history. Additional overflow/breakdown regressions also failed before their correction.

| Full local suite | Tests | Failures / errors / skips |
| --- | ---: | --- |
| Core | 845 | 0 / 0 / 0 |
| Search | 502 | 0 / 0 / 0 |
| Learning | 975 | 0 / 0 / 0 |

The unchanged complete `aiKnowledgeCheck` passed on the final tree in a fresh clean detached checkout: 655685 context units versus accepted baseline 648025 (delta 7660), zero violations, all eight coverage controls, and no hotspot violations. Baseline, thresholds and selectors were unchanged. Six existing nonfatal warnings remain.

The local full `ciCheck` attempt stopped because `mvn` was unavailable on that invocation's PATH; it is not reported as a passed gate. Hosted qualification remains mandatory.

### Measurement boundaries
The real learned/frozen/restored two-occurrence fixture measures eager/lazy query work **197/159**, independent final replay **51/51**, and explicit preparation **465** under the new revision.

The matched B1/L_ORACLE comparison remains diagnostic. Non-output lifecycle work still loses for the oracle: **4775 versus 362** with process reuse, **5830 versus 370** with a fresh process per query. The lower total is driven by output size. This is no L1, wall-clock, memory, family-transfer or economic-learning success claim. Historical measurements retain their original work revision.

See [the checked-schema report](https://github.com/carstenartur/Regelsuche/blob/be423b3f99c5f1e3bb4ea159e2610ecc5e63596a/docs/research/lazy-checked-schema-cursor.md) and [the provider contract](https://github.com/carstenartur/Regelsuche/blob/be423b3f99c5f1e3bb4ea159e2610ecc5e63596a/docs/staged-incremental-provider-contract.md). The acquisition-objective alignment gap remains explicit P06/P07 work.

P04–P12 production implementation is pending. This PR depends on integrated P02 main `f751f90f58ee10aa122c42218b66a13760053aa0`.
